research_question: Is loop-based operation a mathematically and engineering-grounded consequence of LLM structure for agentic tasks?
verdict: The strong universal claim is false, but a conditional version is well supported for long-horizon, open-ended, partially observable, externally verifiable tasks.

sources.title: A Neural Probabilistic Language Model
sources.authors: Yoshua Bengio, Rejean Ducharme, Pascal Vincent, Christian Jauvin
sources.use: Background for neural probabilistic language modeling and conditional next-token distributions.

sources.title: Attention Is All You Need
sources.use: Transformer architecture background; masked decoder self-attention and autoregressive generation context.

sources.title: The Curious Case of Neural Text Degeneration
sources.authors: Ari Holtzman, Jan Buys, Li Du, Maxwell Forbes, Yejin Choi
sources.use: Evidence that likelihood-oriented decoding can produce bland/repetitive generations, motivating non-greedy decoding and tail truncation.

sources.title: On NMT Search Errors and Model Errors: Cat Got Your Tongue?
sources.use: Shows that exact model-score search and beam search can expose model-objective pathologies; model score optimum is not task adequacy.

sources.title: Sampling-Based Approximations to Minimum Bayes Risk Decoding for Neural Machine Translation
sources.use: Contrasts mode-seeking decoding with expected-utility decision rules.

sources.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
sources.use: Repeated reasoning-path sampling and answer aggregation improves reasoning benchmarks over greedy chain-of-thought.

sources.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
sources.use: Interleaves reasoning, action, and observation; evidence for environment-grounded feedback loops.

sources.title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
sources.use: Tool-call use as external computation/lookup incorporated into future token prediction.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.use: Trial-feedback-reflection memory loop for language agents.

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
sources.use: Search over thought states with evaluation and backtracking; strong support for loop/search on planning-like tasks.

sources.title: Let's Verify Step by Step
sources.use: Step-level verification as feedback for multi-step reasoning.

sources.title: WebGPT: Browser-assisted question-answering with human feedback
sources.use: Browser-assisted QA requires search/navigation/reference collection loop.

sources.title: Training Verifiers to Solve Math Word Problems
sources.use: Generate many candidate solutions and select with a verifier.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.use: Important limitation: intrinsic self-correction without external feedback can degrade reasoning.

sources.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
sources.use: Context/memory management for long-running agents.

sources.title: SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?
sources.use: Real-world software engineering tasks require repository interaction and expose limits of non-interactive LMs.

sources.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
sources.use: Interactive coding agent interface, navigation, edit, and test loop.

sources.title: Large Language Monkeys: Scaling Inference Compute with Repeated Sampling
sources.use: Repeated sampling scales coverage when automatic verification is available; also notes selection plateaus without verifiers.

sources.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
sources.authors: Charlie Snell, Jaehoon Lee, Kelvin Xu, Aviral Kumar
sources.use: Test-time compute scaling via verifier search and adaptive strategies; effectiveness depends on problem difficulty.

sources.title: T1: Tool-integrated Self-verification for Test-time Compute Scaling in Small Language Models
sources.authors: Minki Kang, Jongwon Jeong, Jaewoong Cho
sources.use: Recent evidence that tool-integrated verification can improve test-time scaling where internal self-verification is weak.

sources.title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
sources.use: Embodied long-horizon agent with curriculum, skill library, environment feedback, execution errors, and self-verification.

sources.title: Large Language Model Agent: A Survey on Methodology, Applications and Challenges
sources.use: Current survey framing LLM agents through methodology, architecture, collaboration, evolution, evaluation, tools, and challenges.

sources.title: Large Language Models for Planning: A Comprehensive and Systematic Survey
sources.use: Current planning survey categorizing LLM planning methods into external-module augmented, finetuning-based, and searching-based approaches.

sources.title: Step-level Verifier-guided Hybrid Test-Time Scaling for Large Language Models
sources.use: Recent verifier-guided step-level test-time scaling evidence for reasoning loops.

sources.title: Can Language Models Critique Themselves? Investigating Self-Feedback for Retrieval Augmented Generation at BioASQ 2025
sources.use: Recent domain-specific evidence that self-feedback in agentic RAG/deep-research style systems needs empirical comparison against direct expert or external feedback.

sources.authors: Karl J. Astrom, Richard M. Murray
sources.use: Control-theoretic background for open-loop versus closed-loop framing.

sources.authors: Richard S. Sutton, Andrew G. Barto
sources.use: Agent-environment interaction framing for sequential decision-making.
